editorial:
Imagine meeting a guy who celebrates Christmas every single day of the year. That is exactly what happens to Sophie, a stressed-out producer who lives for her job and has totally forgotten how to enjoy the holidays. When she starts filming a reality show about Will, a charming and handsome man with a strange obsession with December 25th, her world gets flipped upside down. The vibe is super cozy and sweet, making you feel like you are wrapped in a warm blanket with a cup of cocoa. It is the perfect kind of movie to put on when you just want to turn your brain off and feel good.

You will love the chemistry between the leads, as they make the romance feel natural and cute. While the plot is pretty predictable, the pacing keeps things moving quickly so you never get bored. If you are looking for a lighthearted escape, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the end, Sophie learns that Will's obsession with Christmas comes from a place of love and loss. After some tension regarding the reality show and their differing lifestyles, they decide to put their careers and doubts aside. Sophie finally lets go of her workaholic habits to embrace the joy of the season. They share a romantic moment and commit to a real relationship, proving that love can happen at any time of the year.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy holiday romances and feel-good stories.
